title: The Cracked Trophy
scene: At 8:30 PM, the school trophy was cracked. The gym doors were locked for the assembly from 8:15 to 8:45.

suspects.name: Mira Cole
suspects.testimony: I was with the team in the locker room at 8:30.
suspects.alibiProof: The team group photo at 8:29 includes Mira.

suspects.name: Noah Fenn
suspects.testimony: I was mopping the hallway at 8:30, outside the gym.
suspects.alibiProof: The hallway camera shows Noah mopping at 8:28 and 8:33.

suspects.name: Olive Sato
suspects.testimony: I was at the assembly microphone at 8:30.
suspects.alibiProof: The sound desk log shows Olive's mic active from 8:25 to 8:38.

suspects.name: Quinn Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in my office at 8:30, signing papers.
suspects.contradiction: The office light was off from 8:20, and trophy glass was embedded in Quinn's shoe.
